conviction_note: The 9M/Q3 numbers are genuinely new: no trading update, no MAR art. 17 notice, and the 1 Oct conference deck only repeats the qualitative FY guide. This name's last four release days moved 0.0/-11.2/-4.9/+17.0% inside the session, so abs_move is set at 8 (European base about 7 for new numbers; 78% realised vol; one-analyst coverage). There is no sourced numeric bar and no unpriced company-level number, so p_up is 51 and the findings sum to +0.3. The sum and the scaled number agree because both rest on nothing decisive.

already_public.what: FY2026 guide (qualitative, reiterated in H1 release): growth of main economic indicators vs 2025 and a further reduction of net financial debt vs 30 Jun 2026 (EUR 120.3m), with H2 acceleration. Provisional award to Tesmec Rail of an SBB/FFS tender for 24 battery catenary vehicles, about CHF 42m over 4 years. Definitive award expected by end-November 2026, first deliveries late 2028 to early 2029. Filed 3 Nov 18:26; the stock closed -4.7% on 4 Nov and -3.5% on 5 Nov (intraday)
CFO and dirigente preposto Ruggero Gambini resigned for personal reasons; Group Chief Accountant Piero Nicodano replaced him from 14 Sep 2026
H1 2026: revenue 144.2m (+12.2%), EBITDA 24.3m (+14.7%), net profit 4.5m, NFP 120.3m, backlog 498.3m. Rail H1 EBITDA 1.5m (7.2% margin) against 4.2m, with the ramp of new contracts guided into H2

NFP at 30 Sep 2026 against 120.3m at June (9M25 went 146.4 -> 136.0 over Q3 2025). The guide is year-end vs June, so a Q3 working-capital build for the rail ramp could lift Q3 NFP without breaching the guide. Unknown, and a possible negative line
most likely a reiteration of the qualitative FY26 guide; a quantified FY26 number or an upgrade would be the large-move case. Unknown

findings.finding: Management has guided that Q3 begins an H2 acceleration: new rail contracts (incl. the EUR 71m Slovenian awards of March) enter execution after H1 rail EBITDA fell to 1.5m, and Energy/stringing keeps growing. Q3 is the first quarter that tests that guide, against a Q3 2025 base of about 63.6m revenue and 10.2m EBITDA.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Release-day moves (close D-1 to close D, release in session): Q1 26 -4.9% on a quarter Websim called better than expected on revenue and debt; H1 26 +17.0% on a 15% EBITDA beat; FY25 -11.2% on results below expectations; 9M25 0.0% on Yahoo (open=close, possibly a stale bar) then +16.4% the next session
findings.original_quote: un trend di acquisizione di nuovi e importanti tender, che hanno anche generato incassi iniziali, con positive attese di crescita nella seconda parte dell'esercizio grazie all'entrata in fase esecutiva di tali nuove commesse (a trend of winning new and important tenders, which also generated initial cash-in, with positive growth expectations in the second half thanks to these new contracts entering execution)
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: it is the company's own guide, repeated on 1 Oct, and it is the bar rather than an edge. Sized near zero because a confirmation lands inside what was guided. If the market doubted the H2 ramp you would expect a sell-side cut or an MAR notice, and neither exists. The 32% fall from the 5 Oct high (0.574 -> 0.391) has no company filing behind it, which is consistent with a momentum unwind rather than a known miss
findings.independence: The 1 Oct 2026 deck repeats the H2 acceleration (https://tesmec-data.teleborsa.it/2026/Tesmec-@-Le-Eccellenze-del-Made-In-Italy_PRINT_20260930_031338.pdf). It is the same issuer, so not independent

findings.finding: Post-period order: Tesmec Rail was provisionally awarded the SBB/FFS CHF 42m catenary-vehicle tender (24 units plus 2x5 options). The release will cite it, but the award is not yet definitive (expected by end-November) and deliveries start late 2028, so it does nothing for 2026 numbers.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Order headlines have moved it before: Terna EUR 54m, July 2025, +13.3% on the day (Milano Finanza). This one was sold: -4.7% on 4 Nov, the first session after the 18:26 filing
findings.original_quote: L'aggiudicazione definitiva è attesa entro la fine di novembre 2026, mentre le prime consegne sono previste fra la fine del 2028 e l'inizio del 2029. (Definitive award is expected by end-November 2026, while first deliveries are planned between late 2028 and early 2029.)
findings.why_not_priced: Public for two sessions and visibly sold, so it is priced. It is kept only as a sentence management will repeat on the call; there is no number in it that the market lacks

findings.finding: The 9M report is the first interim signed by a new dirigente preposto/CFO (Piero Nicodano, internal promotion from Group Chief Accountant, effective 14 Sep 2026) after the previous CFO resigned for stated personal reasons. This is a small, non-zero risk of reporting or provisioning changes.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior CFO change in the sampled window. The stock closed +7.9% on the first session after the 4 Sep notice, i.e. not read as a negative
findings.original_quote: Le dimissioni, concordate con la Società e motivate da ragioni di natura esclusivamente personale connesse alla decisione di intraprendere nuovi progetti di vita, avranno efficacia dal 14 settembre 2026. (The resignation, agreed with the Company and motivated by exclusively personal reasons, takes effect on 14 September 2026.)
findings.why_not_priced: Public for two months and the market ignored it. Kept at -0.1 because the company's own text argues continuity (internal successor, 'piena continuità') and nothing contradicts that

baseline_tension: The baseline lean (+0.66) comes entirely from the -13% 20-day run-up, with no positioning anchor. Nothing found cuts for or against it, so the hunt neither beats nor follows the free control: the drawdown has no documented cause.

lessons_applied: 'The move is in what is new; let reaction history move p_up, not abs_move': the 9M numbers are not pre-released and this name's release days have run 5-17%, so abs_move went 7.5 -> 8.0
'A finding inside the guide goes toward 0': the H2-acceleration finding went +0.3 -> +0.2
'The hunter's own caveat has to reach the number': the CFO finding's own text argues continuity, so -0.2 -> -0.1
'Cash can outweigh a raised guide': Q3 NFP/working capital is flagged in new_in_release as a possible negative line; there is no source for it, so it is not a finding
'Truncated zero is not a measurement': positioning_check says there is no anchor
